body:
GitHub https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/1492

## Summary
Gaps between the corpus MCP `trust_envelope` and what a documentation-serving contract needs per response:
1. No `verified_at`: a reader cannot tell when, if ever, content was verified (content_status is always `generated`).
2. Freshness is one value for the whole answer (`fresh`/`stale`/`unknown`). There is no per-citation anchor state (unchanged, moved, changed, gone) and no way to report that the caller's checkout has diverged from the corpus revision.
3. Supplied free text (claim text, gap reasons, subject names) carries no per-field origin marker (e.g. `origin: untrusted` with its length cap) so a consumer cannot keep third-party prose out of an answer structurally.
4. `docs_gaps` cannot filter by gap kind; a "list all gaps of kind K" question returns everything for a subject or the whole corpus.

## Environment
- Build: main-ef2a01d; ~100k-record, 5-repository corpus.

## Reproduction
1. `docs_get` on a subject whose anchored file later changes only in the cited span of one of its two citations.
2. Observe `freshness: stale` for the receipt with no indication which citation changed.
3. `docs_gaps {kind: "k"}` -> `invalid-arguments`.

## Expected
- `trust_envelope.verified_at` (null with a limitation when never verified).
- Each citation carries `anchor_state` (`live moved changed gone unknown`) from the read-time check; the receipt-level freshness is derived from them.
- Optional caller revision input; when it is not a descendant of the corpus revision, report `diverged`.
- Supplied text fields declare `origin` (`source`, `supplied`, `untrusted`) in the receipt.
- `docs_gaps` accepts `kind` (string or list).

## Acceptance tests
- Two-citation fixture: changing one cited span marks only that citation `changed`.
- `verified_at` is null with a limitation on an unverified corpus.
- `docs_gaps {kind}` returns only that kind, with a per-kind total.
title: GH #1492: corpus MCP trust envelope needs verified_at, per-citation anchor state, field origin, docs_gaps kind filter
